paper_metadata.title: Tailoring strength and ductility of high-entropy CrMnFeCoNi alloy by adding Al

evidence.quote: In this paper, CrMnFeCoNi alloy with outstanding ductility but low strength was selected as baseline alloy to study the formation of hard phase to strengthen this ductile alloy by adding Al into it.
